provenanceNotes: The Visual C++ redistributable URL is the destination of Microsoft's documented permalink https://aka.ms/vc14/vc_redist.x64.exe, resolved on 2026-09-22; the SHA-256 embedded in that URL matches the downloaded bytes.

Microsoft permits licensed Visual Studio users to distribute the Visual C++ runtime files unmodified with their programs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution (Visual C++ Runtime Files) under https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/vs2022-ga-community/ for this MIT-licensed open-source application; the runtime's own terms are linked from https://aka.ms/VCRedistLicense.

The redistributable is read as data only. Its stub, bootstrapper application, MSI packages and custom actions never execute; cabinets are inflated in Python and file names come from the MSI File tables.

The Swift 6.2.3 runtime DLLs come from the swift.org installer already pinned in scripts/windows-cross/dependencies.json (rtl.msi and rtl.cab, whose SHA-512 digests the installer manifest records). No Microsoft runtime file is taken from that installer.
Licence texts are pinned to the release tag commits of the official repositories so the bundle notices cannot drift silently.

swift-runtime-lock.json authenticates every cached Swift DLL against hashes regenerated from the fully SHA-256-verified installer, SHA-512-verified rtl.msi/rtl.cab and reconstructed MSI file identities; cache-local metadata is not trusted.
